periods.summary: Baskerville improvises a birthday for China, giving her kimono, silver spoon, play set and crayons. China draws herself, Kinji's group and a dark dragon-mother figure.
periods.cause: Nursery asks about December birthdays and Kinji does not know China's real birthday.
periods.process: Friends gather, sing, give gifts and watch China draw.
periods.outcome: China receives ordinary childhood happiness and foreshadows Gedronika through her 'mother' drawing.
periods.significance: Symbolizes China's new life and foreshadows her dragon ancestor.
